t: This is the site of Eastminster, also known as New Abbey or St Mary Graces, which was a Cistercian abbey on Tower Hill at East Smithfield. It no longer stands as an abbey, so what you see now is a place to imagine. It was founded by Edward III, who was King of England from 1327 until 1377. His fifty-year reign saw the evolution of Parliament, and also the ravages of the Black Death. He made England one of the most formidable military powers in Europe.
